dedupe_keys.name: eba eu wide transparency exercise bank by bank data

description: The EU-wide transparency exercise is the European Banking Authority's annual publication of detailed, comparable supervisory data on large EU and EEA banks. The 2025 exercise covers 119 banks in 25 countries at the highest level of consolidation, with data on capital, leverage, profit and loss, risk-weighted assets, assets and liabilities, non-performing and forborne exposures and loans to non-financial corporations broken down by NACE economic sector. It is produced by the EBA and complements the banks' own Pillar 3 disclosures under the Capital Requirements Directive. Coverage is the EU and EEA, bank by bank and by country. The data are available free through interactive web tools and downloads, published with the Risk Assessment Report of December 2025, the Risk Assessment Questionnaire booklet and its xlsx statistical annex, and a mapping to the COREP and FINREP reporting templates. Caveats: only the largest banks are included, figures are supervisory reporting data at consolidated level, and the page read gives no reuse licence. For simulation it gives bank-level balance sheets and sector exposures to parameterise contagion and resilience models of the banking system and to trace which banks are most exposed to sectors such as energy or construction. It is related to the EBA EU-wide stress testing record in this catalogue, which uses a smaller sample under adverse scenarios.
